lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A series of high-luminance, roughly circular pixel clusters arranged in multiple vertical columns posterior to the gill region. The spacing between centroids increases along the longitudinal axis towards the posterior.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Visible vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect with the primary circular blobs, forming a discernible grid-like structure across the lateral flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A distinct horizontal linear feature is observed along the upper third of the visible flank, characterized by a sharp vertical luminance gradient with high intensity above and shadow below.

other_distinctive_markers: Presence of multiple commensal fish (remoras) clustered around the ventral region and trailing edge of the pectoral fin.
